notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Second Part of Major Update)
notes.content:
Hello everybody. The second part of the major update will be occurring next week. The update
will feature more maps, more enemies, more units (Friendly and Hostile) and more buildings.

There will also be a few graphical changes that occur on this update.

Thank you for your time.

notes.title: Upcoming Update - The Ancient Lands
notes.content:
Sorry it has been awhile everybody. But, I am back to updating The Ancient Lands. I owe the community an apology for the lack of content the last several months.

Updates will be made starting on November 23 on a bi-weekly basis to add more content as well as to make various changes to The Ancient Lands.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.content:
The Ancient Lands has updated to version 0.3.0.0. 

* Left clicking will bring up the closest enemy target and display their current stats.
* Slight change to combat.
* While in game and when the game is paused, you can click on controls to bring up controls screen instead of having to go back to title screen and going to controls that way. You can also press Backspace to bring up the control screen without having to pause.
* Fixed a few typo errors and re-devised some of the descriptions of buildings, powers, and units.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.content: Fixed a issue where I forgot to delete units for testing purposes.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.content:
Sorry about the late update today. I planned on doing this update much earlier, but some life situations popped up. This is the release of version 0.2.2.5.
[b]Additions[/b]
* A simple save system was developed. It still has some kinks to work out, but it is functional. When you are in the game. You can press tab and the save game option will pop up. Clicking it will save your progress and while you are in a game, you can press K to load your last saved progress.
* Stables have been added to the game. They are required to build Cavalry units.
* A new building, the Sanctuary has been added. This building trains units regarding only prayer.
They have no upkeep of gold or food to worry about.
* Minor Defenders can now be trained (They spawn from the Guardians Spell)
* Maughs has been added to the game. They can be trained from the Sanctuary.
They are destructive units that deals AoE damage when destroyed.
* A new power, Fireburst Spell has been added. It has the power to deal immense fire damage and stun any enemy unit caught within its grasp.

[b]Animals[/b]
* On 5/31/20 (tomorrow), I will update the animals into the game. This took more time than I expected it would take. But expect to see animals in the tomorrow update.

[b]Keybinding[/b]
* This is gonna be a hard thing to implement. The way the gaming engine I am using works, it is gonna take awhile. But expect to see this in feature in future updates.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.content:
This is a surprise update. This includes some of the things I am working on toward version 0.2.2.5.
[b]Additions[/b]
* Ability to toggle health bars on and off
* Ability to toggle HUD on and off (Powers are still shown)

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
* Enemies are now stronger, but there are a little less of them
* Villagers in stone deposits can only mine when enemies are not present
* Prayer Tower now deals 150 damage instead of 100
* Spawn chance increased from 65 to 75

[b]Tweaks[/b]
* Tutorial has been reworked to provide a better understanding
* Info about unit gold costs are now shown when you hover to train units
* More info is revealed throughout regarding certain units or structures
* Menu shows up when you die
* Did some general optimization to make things run more efficiently

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.content:
There will be a update to the game on May 30, 12:00pm EST. I plan on adding quite a few features to the game.
I plan on adding:
* A new power for you to use
* The ability to rebind keys
* Two more friendly units and two new structures.
* Adding animals into the game

I plan on tweaking:
* Help optimize the game by reducing the amount of enemy spawns by just a few, but make them stronger in return and just general optimizations throughout.
